_role: AUTHORITY. This file is the only machine-read source for kit pack membership. docs/standards/kit-pack-membership.md is GENERATED from it and must never be hand-edited: `pnpm kit:generate` writes it, `pnpm kit:check` regenerates and byte-compares. Nothing in this repository parses that Markdown to establish a fact — a predecessor lane HALTed REGION_THRASH after three rounds closing successively finer Markdown boundaries, and the remaining edge set is bounded by the CommonMark spec, not by care.
_freezing_rule: Record every value WITH its provenance and measurement date, and mark anything measured outside this repository as stale-by-construction. Otherwise we freeze an unmeasured premise into the authority file — which is precisely what this file exists to prevent.
_wiring_rule: A mechanism may be described as ACTIVE only when its wiring point is measured: who invokes it, where, and an observed run or failure. Reading its code is not enough. A document describing it is not enough. This repository already runs that measurement on product code (resolveCapability with zero callers, authorizeTenantAction dark for eight days, chat_* tables with no reader) and had never run it on its own tooling.
